args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the vacation itinerary for Hawaii (June 10-20, 2024), here are the essential items to pack:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike and other outdoor adventures)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and general activities)
- Camera (to capture memories of the beautiful Hawaiian scenery)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, hotel reservations, etc.)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and sandals (for Waikiki Beach day)
- Snorkeling equipment (if not renting at Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable hiking shoes (for Diamond Head hike)
- Light rain jacket (for potential tropical showers)
- Formal attire (for the Luau experience)
- Waterproof phone case (for water activities)

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Portable charger
- Reusable water bottle
